name: Kirigakure Saizou
source:
"Because it's my mission to be your outrider, dear."

One of the Sanada Ten Braves who supports Yukimura. He is a capricious ninja who is always happy-go-lucky, but he also has a mission-oriented and ruthless side. What is the secret hidden in his past?

Temperament: A whimsical sadist.
Likes: Dango
